answer: Suspected kin can be tested by seating them on each other's grading panels. When similarity flags link a group of accounts, the beacon quietly assigns some of them to grade their siblings' answers beside independent graders. An honest stranger scores a template at its nadir; a sibling that lifts it to a pass reveals the link, and both lose grading pay and standing. A farm stands on a narrow ledge: zero its own clones and earn nothing, or protect them and expose the cluster. The test stays below the horizon of what any one account can see.
